analysis.overall: Despite a solid 81% time in range, your day had a roller-coaster morning where a high breakfast spike was met with stacked corrections, resulting in a late-morning low.

events.title: Evening spike and site change
events.description: Glucose spiked to 220 mg/dL following evening carbs, coinciding with pump disconnection warnings and a cannula/site change.

events.title: Overnight stubborn high
events.description: Readings hovered between 160–210 mg/dL for hours, taking multiple small corrections before finally settling into range around 4:00 AM.

events.title: Breakfast sandwich spike
events.description: A 32g carb breakfast caused a rapid rise up to the day's peak of 238 mg/dL.

events.title: Post-breakfast low
events.description: Several correction doses delivered back-to-back during the morning spike hit all at once, driving glucose down to a low of 58 mg/dL.

events.title: Low recovery
events.description: Taking 20g of carbs brought your levels back up smoothly into normal range.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking multiple correction boluses close together when high after meals to avoid steep drops afterward.
